fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Off until you turn it on. While off, the MCP endpoint refuses every request.

fields.label: Endpoint
fields.options: Point your AI client at /api/method/orbit.api.mcp on this site. Authentication is this site's own: an API key pair, an OAuth token, or a session. Every call runs as the user behind that credential, under their own permissions.

fields.label: Restrict to role
fields.description: If set, only users with this role may use Orbit at all. The narrowest control here, and the first one to reach for.

fields.options: Reading is always allowed, bounded by each user's own permissions. The three below are separate on purpose: saving a draft, posting it to the ledger, and deleting it are different decisions with different consequences. A tool that is switched off is not advertised to the agent at all.

fields.label: Allow submit and cancel
fields.description: Submitting runs on_submit: it posts ledger entries and moves stock. Cancelling reverses that and leaves a permanent trail.

fields.label: Allow delete
fields.description: No undo. Prefer cancelling a submitted document over deleting it.

fields.label: Allowed DocTypes
fields.description: One per line, or comma separated. If set, these are the only DocTypes Orbit will touch at all - reads included. The strongest control available here.

fields.label: Never write these DocTypes
fields.description: Added to a built-in list that already covers Server Script, Custom Field, User, DocType and the rest of the records that change how the site itself behaves.

fields.label: Max rows per call
fields.description: A ceiling, not a suggestion. It stops an agent filling its own context with rows it did not need.

fields.label: Log every tool call
fields.description: Writes an Orbit Audit Log entry per call, refusals included. Refusals are the interesting half.

fields.label: Include arguments in the log
fields.description: Off by default: a tool call can carry customer data, and logging it puts a copy in a second place.
